period_note: SOLO / STANDALONE basis (a Consolidated version incl. Islami Bank Securities Ltd and Islami Bank Capital Management Ltd also appears in the source and is not used). Income-statement figures are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2023 (the filing's own '01 Jan to 31 March 2023' column); for Q1 this is identical to the discrete quarter. Source is a scanned/signed copy with no text layer, OCR'd via tesseract. Balance sheet ties within BDT 1 (total liabilities 1,717,230,743,199 + equity 68,453,577,901 = 1,785,684,321,100 vs reported total assets 1,785,684,321,099); the 5 deposit sub-lines sum exactly to the deposits total; the 4 equity sub-lines sum exactly to equity; total liabilities is independently reproduced exactly from its own components (placement + deposits + Mudaraba Bond + other liabilities + deferred tax = 1,717,230,743,199). P&L operating-income and expense sub-lines sum exactly to their totals; PBT 2,396,202,075 minus 'Provision for taxation for the period' 1,889,400,972 (the full tax charge; 'Deferred tax' of 21,113,874 is a memo sub-component, not additive) reproduces PAT 506,801,103 exactly. The liabilities section's 'Mudaraba Bond' (31,000,000,000) is the parent of 'Perpetual bond' (11,000,000,000) and 'Redeemable Subordinated Bond' (20,000,000,000), which sum to it exactly; only the parent is counted in total liabilities. This interim filing does not disclose the absolute Classified Investment balance, only the provision held/movement against it (Note 11.1); classified_loans and npl_pct are therefore not available. Note 11.1's comparative column is the full prior year (FY2022). Note 11.1 is fully clean and internally consistent for this quarter: the Opening, D (provision made during the period, incl. its Classified sub-item), and Closing rows all sum correctly across every sub-item (Unclassified/Classified/Off-Balance-Sheet), and D's total (1,951,940,000) is independently confirmed by the P&L's own 'Provision for investments & off-balance sheet items' line for the same period; no OCR correction was needed for this note. One P&L sub-line that is not part of this dataset's schema, 'Provision for diminution in value of investments in shares', printed blank in the main account for the current period, but is independently confirmed as 184,388,933 by Annexure-A's cash-flow reconciliation in the same document; the parent 'Total provision' line used for provision_charge_cumulative (2,150,034,658) was itself printed clearly and did not need correction, and reconciles exactly once this sub-line is included (1,951,940,000+184,388,933+13,705,725=2,150,034,658).
